method: Read-only checks in the managed cloud Chrome browser following secure staff sign-in. Credentials, session data, private source URLs, staff identifiers, record identifiers and screenshots are excluded.

initialChecks.name: staff-sign-in
initialChecks.evidence: Authenticated dashboard and staff-only content/story desks rendered.

defectFound.name: paused-preview-first-frame-timeout
defectFound.description: A fully buffered, deliberately paused preview became unavailable when the mount-time 15-second first-frame deadline expired before staff pressed Play. Immediate retry and Play worked. This was reproduced in focused tests and corrected without changing authorization or the media proxy.

limitations: No content, staff, moderation or security settings were changed in these browser checks.
The hosted dataset has fewer than one server page of posts; larger pagination is covered by controlled tests.
This receipt establishes sampled QA acceptance, not production latency or every browser/device.
